The '''Koensayr Yards''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located on [[Koensayr]]. [[Power converter/Legends|Power converters]] were stolen from the Koensayr Yards and incorporated into the ''[[Cannibal]]'', a unique [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operated by [[Barosa Warren]].
